download_modal.title: Install the VS Code extension
download_modal.description: The extension captures your active VS Code file and sends it to the room — only the Host needs to install it.
download_modal.step1: Download the .vsix file using the button below.
download_modal.step3: Choose "Extensions: Install from VSIX..." and select the downloaded file.
